ad_intro:
Urban Company (urbancompany.com) is a Home Services brand running ~55 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.2-3 Cr/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Home-services marketplace worth >$2B at its peak, spanning beauty and repairs.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: service-led, before/after ugc thin - The gap: before/after service UGC. (2) Landing page: a service menu without before/after proof or verified-professional trust. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Service-led, before/after UGC thin. The gap: before/after service UGC.
Copy leak: Current angle is product-led. Missing angle: transparent pricing + verified-professional story.
Landing page leak: A service menu without before/after proof or verified-professional trust.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy before/after service UGC
Shoot 15 fifteen-second before/after service UGC and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add before/after galleries, verified-professional badges, and transparent pricing. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
